spans.s: ग॑न्तवे & ग॑न्तवै॑ dat. inf. to go.
ग॑न्तु m. way, course.
गन्तुकाम a. willing to go.

ग॑न्तृ going or coming to (acc., loc. or *dat.). used also
as fut. pp. (f. गकमी).

गन्ध॑ m. (n.) smell, odour, fragrance, fragrant
substance, perfume (mostly pl.);
 the mere smell i.e. a bit of, some
likeness with (—˚).
गन्धक f. इका smelling of (—˚).
गन्धगज m. scent-elephant (i.e. an elephant in rut).
गन्धगुण m. the quality of smell.
गन्धद्विप m. = गन्धद्वज.
गन्धद्विरद m. = गन्धद्वज.

गन्धन m. a sort of rice;
 n. smelling.
गन्धमादन m. N. of a mountain and forest.
गन्धमाल्य n. du. & pl. fragrances and garlands.
गन्धयुक्ति f. preparation or application of perfumes.
गन्धर्वराज m. the king of the Gandharvas.
गन्धर्वलोक॑ m. the world of the Gandharvas.
गन्धवन्त् a. smelling, odoriferous.
गन्धवह m. the wind (bearer of odours).
गन्ध˚वाह m. the wind (bearer of odours).
*गन्धसार m. sandal-wood.
गन्धाढ्य a. rich in odours, fragrant.
गन्धार m. pl. N. of a people.
गन्धा॑रि m. pl. N. of a people.
गान्धारि m. pl. N. of a people.
गन्धोद्दाम a. perfumed, odoriferous.
गान n. singing, song.

गान्धर्वविधि m. the Gandharva marriage (v.
prec.).
